QuestInfo.name: Strengthening Your Mech
QuestInfo.0: Checky knows of a way to make your Mech even stronger. Head to the Secret Base.
QuestInfo.1: Checky knows of a way to make your Mech even stronger. Head to the Secret Base.
QuestInfo.2: Checky gave you a Copper Engine to add to your Mech, making it even stronger. He says you can become even more powerful if you gather other parts as well.

0.0: Whoa, #h0#! Lv. 50 already, eh? You're well on your way to pulverizing the Black Wings.
0.1: But you're not quite ready to face them yet. Let me teach you a Mechanic trick that'll make you stronger. Interested?

yes.0: Excellent. There are Black Wing spies everywhere, so meet me at the Secret Base. You DO remember where that is, right?

no.0: Think about it, #h0#. Just think about it.
